Software Development Engineer in Test I (SDET)
Seattle, WA
Full-time
Onsite
Entry Level
$86K/yr - $115K/yr
Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC is seeking a Software Development Engineer in Test I to support quality engineering and test automation for its advertising systems. The role develops and executes automated and manual tests, reports issues, and collaborates with engineers and QA leads to help deliver reliable products.
Media and Entertainment
Broadcasting
Film Production
Responsibilities
Assist in the design, development, and maintenance of automated test scripts under the guidance of senior engineers
Execute manual and automated test cases for UI, API, and integration testing, reporting bugs and issues clearly and promptly
Participate in basic code reviews and gain hands-on experience with test frameworks and software development tools
Collaborate closely with software engineers, SDETs, and QA leads to understand system functionality and testing requirements
Attend team meetings, design discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions to continuously improve your understanding of testing practices and team processes
Seek and act on feedback to grow your technical and problem-solving abilities
Qualification
Python
Software Testing
Test Automation
Required
Proficiency with Python
Understanding of basic software testing principles and interest in automation
Strong communication, organization, and teamwork skills
Eagerness to learn, adapt, and receive feedback in a fast-paced environment
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable field of study, or equivalent work experience
